SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.title: Bollo
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.firstVisit: Never bet on avoiding my attention
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.ANY.0-0r.a: Does chance favour you today, do you think?
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.ANY.1-0r.a: Cuting across the fabric of fate again?
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.DEFECT.0-0: What foolish hand does Neow play by sending me a broken automaton?
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.DEFECT.1-0:
And how am I supposed to play a game of chance with one who is himself so...


[thinky_dots]DETERMINISTIC?[/thinky_dots]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.DEFECT.2-0: The architect said [thinky_dots]WHAT[/thinky_dots] about foreseeing your arrival[thinky_dots]??[thinky_dots]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.IRONCLAD.0:
[sine]Ahhh, The Ironclad.
I have it on [red]good authority[/red] that you are one to appreciate a good deal.[/sine]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.IRONCLAD.1: You rush forward so blind with rage your actions might as well be entirely decided by chance
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.IRONCLAD.2: Neow? She would use you, as she uses all...
...The Architect? He would remove you, not to interfere with his grand designs...
[jitter][b]BUT I? I WOULD UNLEASH YOU UPON THE WORLD SO A NEW ONE MAY HAVE A CHANCE TO ARISE FROM THE ASHES[/b][/jitter]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.0-0: A hunt is but a game with [red]lives at stake[/red], little gambler.
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.1-0: Your sisters tried to cheat, I know. Were they any good at it, one of them would be my little knife now, not you
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.2-0: Time and time again, you outplay us one and all by refusing to cheat
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.2-2: Were I not as impressed, I would hate you for it, my little ace in the hole
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.NECROBINDE: What is the purpose of lugging around a giant hand if you have no intent of dealing me any cards?
[jitter][b]MY FAMILIAR[/b] is not a toy to be used for frivolous games of chance!![/jitter]

[jitter]That thing is as much your toy as you are mine[/jitter].
 As for [jitter]CHANCE[/jitter], it is the least frivolous thing in existence.
Consider this, little mage. She has the power to bring you back, she does. And yet, she always brings you back... [jitter]like that[/jitter]
To me, that seems like a weird rule. And weird rules make for the [b]best[/b] cheating opportunities

How can you not see this is not a game to me?
Never was, never will be.

[jitter][b]EVERYTHING IS A GAME[/b][jitter]
The sooner you accept that, the sooner you can start [jitter]winning[/jitter]

Were the universe as unknowable as you believe, you may not have had an offer for me now. Yet we both know I am your last ace in the hole.
[b]Let's hear it.[/b]

Ah, she decides to start cheating at last. Would that you were as willing to play.
 [sine]Small victories.[/sine] Have at it
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.0-0: I seek an audience with one [sine]Bollo[/sine] - a cosmic being that is supposedly enamoured with [b]Chance[/b] and [b]Fate[/b] and the [jitter][b]VIRTURE THAT IS GREED[/b][/jitter]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.0-1: It is I that you gaze upon, [jitter]little princeling.[/jitter]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.0-2:
How odd.
I would not have expected you to be so... [b]pedestrian.[/b]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.1-0: Tell me of something that you would be willing to trade for a chance at The Architect
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.1-1: [i][font_size=22]The Regent spends exactly one hour, seventeen minutes, and twelve seconds listing his various lands and titles[/font_size][/i]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.1-2: [i][font_size=20]The Regent spends twenty two more minutes listing monetary funds in several intergalactic currencies he has access to[/font_size][/i]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.1-3: [i][font_size=18]Finally, The Regent spends fourty five minutes reciting his most valuable material posessions[/font_size][/i]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.1-4:
I am certain that must all sound so grand to you.
But now, please try and offer me something [jitter][b][/b]INTERESTING[/jitter]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.REGENT.2-0: Our best bet? Not subterfuge, not the old magics - but your own delusions of grandeur trumping even The Architect's.
